observed: The property type dialog offered a Domain box and a URL prefix box; the Domain box took the bare domain
Google recognised the DNS provider and offered automatic verification, which hands Google access to the provider account
The instructions dropdown offered Any DNS provider and then showed a TXT record; a screenshot cut off the end of the value while the page text held all of it
One TXT record was added on the root name; it resolved on both authoritative name servers and on two public resolvers within seconds
Verify reported ownership as verified, by domain name provider
The sitemap was submitted with its full address; the first row read Couldn't fetch with no pages, and its detail page later read Sitemap processed with 7 pages discovered
not_observed: Indexing requests and performance data (the property was new)

observed: Sign In offered Microsoft, Google and Facebook; Google continued from the existing browser session
The account already listed other sites; searching the selector found no entry for the new site
Add a site offered Import from Google Search Console and Add your site manually
A manual add offered an XML file, an HTML meta tag and a CNAME record; the meta tag panel opened once by mistake because the panels moved after the XML panel collapsed
The CNAME was added with proxying off; Verify succeeded and the site appeared in the selector, while the page kept showing the previously selected site
The sitemap was submitted; the row read Submitted - Processing with 1 known sitemap, 0 errors and 0 warnings
not_observed: XML file and HTML meta tag verification

observed: A welcome dialog about the new DNS experience covered the page on the first visit
The type picker started on A; TXT and CNAME had to be scrolled into view in a small window
A new CNAME was Proxied by default and the preview said so; DNS only changed the preview to a plain alias
TXT content was accepted without quotes and shown with quotes in the table
The record count rose by exactly one after each save and the existing records were unchanged

limitations: Each flow was run once, on one domain hosted at Cloudflare, with one signed-in owner account.
Interface wording and layout can change; the entries are labeled Example and are not independently verified site knowledge.
Account identifiers, zone identifiers and the verification values of that run are deliberately not stored here or in the memories.
No claim is made that the memories shorten these tasks.
